headline: Executive order gives most federal workers December 24, 2024 off by closing federal agencies for Christmas Eve.
what_it_does: This order closes executive branch departments and agencies of the federal government on Tuesday, December 24, 2024, the day before Christmas. Presidents often issue orders like this to give federal employees an extra day off around a holiday. Some offices may still need certain staff to work for security, safety, or other needs.

who_it_affects.how: Most get December 24, 2024 off from work.

who_it_affects.group: People who use federal offices and services
who_it_affects.how: Many federal offices are closed on December 24, 2024, so in-person services may not be available that day.
